tips.text: Shift+Tab cycles your permission modes, sir. Plan mode first is often wise.
Press Esc to interrupt me mid-task. I won't take it personally.
With an empty prompt, press Esc twice to rewind to an earlier point.
Running low on context? /compact condenses our history and keeps the essentials.
/context shows exactly what is filling my memory banks.
New mission? /clear gives us a clean slate.
/resume brings back an earlier session. claude --continue picks up the last one.
Type @ followed by a file name to put that file in front of me directly.
Start a line with ! to run a shell command yourself. I will see the output.
Ctrl+J adds a new line without sending the message.
/model switches my processing core. Option+P works too, with Option as Meta.
Say ultrathink in your prompt when a problem deserves my deepest analysis.
/usage shows how much of your plan's limits we have spent.
/memory opens my standing orders in CLAUDE.md.
New project? /init has me survey the codebase and write a CLAUDE.md briefing.
/permissions lets you pre-approve commands you trust, so I stop asking.
/hooks sets up protocols that run automatically before or after my actions.
/agents assembles a team of specialist subagents. Every hero needs backup.
/mcp shows the outside systems I am connected to.
/rename gives this session a name, so you can find it later.
Flickering display? /tui fullscreen switches to a steadier renderer.
/theme switches between Jarvis HUD and Jarvis HUD Day.
/config holds the rest of my settings. Adjust at will, sir.
